name: gitranks-contribute
description: Work on open-source issues picked for you; you approve each pull request on gitranks.com.

token.title: GitRanks token (optional)
token.description: Leave it empty: you sign in to gitranks.com in your browser instead. Only for clients without sign-in: a token from gitranks.com → Contribute → Settings → Your own agent (MCP), starting with gr_.
